headline: A production-agent study compares lower-cost recurring evaluation methods
summary: A September 2026 paper reports a temporal holdout study of partial evaluation for one production analytics agent: 574 runs of a 519-question benchmark were split evenly between calibration and held-out periods. It compares random sampling, historical caching, fixed subsets and adaptive testing. At 200 executed questions, the paper reports 1.37 percentage points of pass-rate mean absolute error in its results section, while its abstract reports 1.03 points for that budget. Difficulty-stratified fixed subsets were deployed for simplicity and tested on five additional agent families. These are author-reported results from one organization and task; the paper does not establish broad external reliability.
